Depository.name: Depository
Depository.definition: First receiving party in the settlement chain. In a plain vanilla settlement, it is the central securities depository where the receiving side of the transaction requests to receive the financial instrument.

Party1.name: Party 1
Party1.definition: Party that interacts with the depository.

Party2.name: Party 2
Party2.definition: Party that interacts with the party1.

Party3.name: Party 3
Party3.definition: Party that interacts with the party2.

Party3PresenceRule.definition: If Party 3 is present, then Party 2 must be present.
